Thanks Dylan — good recap. A few answers from our side: 

1) Expected volumes:
- Pilot (next 2–3 months): ~20M–35M tokens/month.
- If pilot succeeds, we expect to ramp to ~60M–80M tokens/month by Q4.

2) Target monthly budget band for pilot: $8k–$12k / month (we're aiming for ~ $10k/month as a target).

3) Target unit economics: we're hoping for something in the ballpark of $/1M tokens = $400 per 1M tokens. That would make a $10k budget line up with ~25M tokens.

Procurement thresholds and timing:
- Anything under $25k total can be handled on our commercial card (fast).
- Commits or contract values above $25k will go through procurement + legal review — typical cycle 3–4 weeks.
- For $50k+ we usually require a formal SOW + security questionnaire + SOC 2 review (our security team will want evidence).

If you can send a simple 1-page proposal that shows a few unit-price options (PAYG, 3-mo commit, annual), plus SOC2, that'd be perfect.

Cheers,
